answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 4350 Country: India Title: I wish to start a business of Exporting Ladies Suits from India to various countries across the world. My 1st customer, who is also a Muslim, says that while despatching the goods from India to his country (In Africa), I should not declare the actual value of goods which I shall be sending but something less than that. eg: Goods worth Rs. 10,000/- may be declared as Goods worth Rs. 1,000/- in order to avoid Tax/Duty which would be paid by him & by me to the respective Governments. Is this permissible according to The Deen of Allah SWT? Question: As salam o alaikum Mufti sahab I wish to start a business of Exporting Ladies Suits from India to various countries across the world. My 1st customer, who is also a Muslim, says that while despatching the goods from India to his country (In Africa), I should not declare the actual value of goods which I shall be sending but something less than that. eg: Goods worth Rs. 10,000/- may be declared as Goods worth Rs. 1,000/- in order to avoid Tax/Duty which would be paid by him & by me to the respective Governments. Is this permissible according to The Deen of Allah SWT? Answer ID: 4350 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1006/870=B/1429) The additional income in case of unrevealing the actual value is lawful by Shariah but since it is illegal therefore one should avoid saying something unreal: الکذب مباح لاحیاء حقہ ودفع الظلم عن نفسہ ( الشامی: 9/612 ) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
